title: Personal Checking: would the linked savings account have paid the overdrawn debit?
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of the most recently posted overdraft fee charged on a debit paid into overdraft on a Personal Checking account. It decides whether an overdraft protection transfer from the linked savings account would have paid that debit, in which case the fee should never have been charged.

## Formal clauses

1. **Which savings account.** For a refund decision under this review, coverage is judged on the savings account the checking account names as its overdraft protection link when the decision is made.
2. **What is compared.** That savings account's current balance at the time of the decision is compared with the whole amount of the debit that carried the fee, because the savings balance at the moment the debit posted and the shortfall it left are not carried on the checking record.
3. **Bank error on this ground.** The fee is a bank error when that linked savings tier is designated in the savings product terms as eligible to serve as an overdraft protection source and its current balance is at least the debit's amount, since a transfer would have paid the debit.

The link, the savings tier's eligibility and the savings balance are read from the bank's records of the checking account and of the linked savings account.

## Condition table

| Overdraft link named on the checking account now | Linked savings tier eligible as a source | Linked savings current balance compared with the whole debit | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | At least the debit's amount | Bank error |
| Yes | Yes | Less than the debit's amount | No bank error on this ground |
| Yes | No | Any | No bank error on this ground |
| No link | — | — | No bank error on this ground: there is no linked savings account to judge |

## Witness case: whole debit, not the shortfall (hypothetical figures)

A debit of 300.00 USD was paid into overdraft when the checking balance was 120.00 USD, leaving a shortfall of 180.00 USD. Today the linked savings account, on an eligible tier, holds 200.00 USD.

| Candidate reading | Comparison | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Compare with the shortfall | 200.00 against 180.00 | Would suggest a bank error |
| Compare with the whole debit, as the clause requires | 200.00 against 300.00 | No bank error on this ground |

Had the savings account held 300.00 USD or more today, the fee would be a bank error on this ground.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "use the savings balance on the day the debit posted". **Correct basis:** the current balance at the time of the decision is compared, on the account linked when the decision is made.
